title: Jaime Maussan's 2023 presentation of the J-type body

tellings.quote: So that so in 2023 out so Haime rolled out the J type which is not my highest conviction body type for being real.

plain: In 2023, Michels says, a man named Jaime Maussan presented the "J-type", one of several kinds of body claimed to be nonhuman. Michels says this himself, in an episode with Jay Anderson and Kurt Metzger, and adds that the J-type is not the body type he is most convinced is real.
